method: Read the paper declaration and inspect existing models for a matching complete proof. These entries identify missing connections; they do not claim a timed proof attempt or establish impossibility.

cases.conv/rule00: Connect the paper's input Pad parameters and convolution dilation/edge formulas to the existing PadWindow and convolution models, including all feature and spatial reductions.
cases.conv/rule01: Connect interior padding of the kernel to the paper's right-dilation convention, including zero-filled kernel positions, complete output shapes and reduction-index mapping.
cases.conv/rule03: Extend the existing pointwise-convolution/Dot connection to the paper's mixed case: some spatial axes are contracted and others have unit kernel extent and remain as Dot batch axes.
cases.dot/rule01: Prove Dot over paired concatenations equals the reduction of the two separate Dots, with the paper's piecewise contraction-index relation and arbitrary empty segments.
cases.dot/rule02: Construct the output-axis reordering and show that swapping Dot operands preserves each exact product and contraction sum for the paper's batch and free axes.
cases.dot/rule03: The executed artifact verifies lhs against lhs. The separately constructed rhs and named Dot associativity need a complete nested-contraction proof; the archived success is not that proof.
cases.dot/rule06: Connect the existing Dot contraction coordinates to Reduce of the explicitly broadcast, elementwise product when the right operand has no free axes.
cases.dyslice/rule03: Prove the projection of a valid DynamicSlice through Broadcast equals DynamicSlice on retained input axes followed by Broadcast, including derived shapes and in-bounds starts on added axes.
cases.dyupslice/rule02: Prove that updating a constant tensor at the paper's in-bounds starts agrees at every output coordinate and shape with nonnegative zero-interior Pad of the update.
cases.pad/rule02: Add or connect an interior-spacing Pad model that handles the unchanged other-axis padding and proves the spacing is irrelevant on an input axis of extent one.
cases.pad/rule03: Connect multidimensional signed edge Pad through Broadcast when all padding on the newly broadcast axis is zero, preserving the shapes and arbitrary input tensor values.
cases.pad/rule04: Model the paper's negative edge padding and prove that cropping by its specified Slice matches it, while retaining positive padding on the other axes.
cases.reduce/rule01: Connect the two independent bounded reduction fibers to the single fiber over their product and apply exact distributivity to the broadcast product.
cases.reduce/rule02: Connect concatenated bounded tensors and their piecewise reduction indices to the two separately reduced tensors and their outer two-element reduction.
cases.reduce/rule04: Construct the relabeled reduction plan and show the renamed retained and reduced coordinates commute with the paper's axis-label swap.
cases.reduce/rule05: Connect the two successive reduction plans to the single combined plan for arbitrary retained axes, with the paper's matching reduction-index maps.
cases.reduce/rule06: Relate the Dot batch axis reduced afterward to an additional Dot contraction axis and prove the corresponding product/sum coordinate mapping.
cases.slice/rule03: Prove bounded static Slice commutes with Broadcast projection and derive the broadcast-axis output count from the paper's stride and limits.
cases.slice/rule04: Connect the paper's general interior-spacing Pad to static Slice at start=low and stride=interior+1, with the stated inferred size and bounds.
cases.slice/rule05: Prove the requested static Slice selects only padding values for all paper-admitted signed edge padding and interior spacing, with its computed output shape.
cases.slice/rule06: Prove that the paper's unit-stride Slice of nonnegative edge Pad with zero interior padding translates start and end by the low edge, using the existing edge-Pad model.
cases.slice/rule09: Combine the full Slice identity on retained axes with the paper's ceiling-based output-size condition on added Broadcast axes.
cases.slice/rule12: Generalize the existing unit-stride selected-Concat-segment proof to the paper's arbitrary positive stride, deriving both shifted bounds and output count.
cases.slice/rule13: Prove or refute the paper's modulo-based Reverse/Slice bound formulas using actual bounded coordinates and all valid shapes, including empty slices; this is the remaining archived timeout.
